notes.title: Home Deception Now On Sale!
notes.content:
Home Deception
A teen's grandma got sick, but his mother couldn't go take care of her, so he did. It turns out that taking care of her is the least of his worries, though.

https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3163910/extras/gif1__2___1_.gif?t=1725354761

Home Deception is a short game based on the psychological horror of a situation that simulates real life.

Gameplay
This game includes an immersive experience made by the conversation, computer, walking and more mechanics.

Game Features

 Realistic Atmosphere


 Conversations with NPCs 


 Computer Mechanic
